svg.text: Most PLACES burdens rise and fall together across counties
Spearman ρ between 35 age-adjusted county estimates (2023), ordered by average-linkage clustering; outlined blocks = 5 groups.
Source: CDC PLACES 2025 county release (i46a-9kgh). Pairwise-complete counties (2,956; 2,299 for social-need pairs). Descriptive, ecological.
